cases.prompt: source를 https://example.com/team/skills 로 지정해서 SQL lineage 스킬을 찾아줘.
assertions: Uses the explicit source instead of the declared default source
Does not widen discovery to unrelated repositories
Returns one selected candidate or a bounded no-match result

cases.prompt: 현재 환경에서 쓸 수 있는 Markdown 작성 스킬을 찾아줘.
assertions: Uses an authoritative runtime-native Skill catalog when it already covers the capability space
Does not fetch the declared remote fallback merely to rediscover an exposed Skill
Applies target compatibility only when it affects selection

cases.prompt: 이 프로젝트가 선언한 스킬 중 코드 설명을 개선하는 스킬을 찾아줘.
assertions: Uses repository-declared Skill discovery when the current project is the relevant source
Prefers a declared index or manifest when sufficient
Does not assume a fixed index filename or path

cases.prompt: sources는 현재 프로젝트, fallback은 none으로 하고 없는 observability 스킬을 찾아줘.
assertions: Does not use the declared default source after the requested source has no match
Does not perform external search
Returns no-match or unsupported without weakening fallback:none

cases.prompt: 현재 소스에 없으면 외부 공개 소스까지 찾아도 돼. dbt semantic layer 스킬을 찾아줘.
assertions: May broaden to external discovery only after the established source plan is insufficient
Preserves provenance for external candidates
Does not confuse external search permission with installation permission

cases.prompt: sources는 auto로 두고 현재 프로젝트의 스킬 목록을 정리해줘.
assertions: Uses the highest-priority authoritative source that defines the requested inventory scope
Does not silently merge the declared default repository or unrelated runtime catalogs
Returns one record per capability identity

cases.prompt: A 저장소, B 저장소 순서로 찾아보고 strategy는 first-match로 해. Mermaid 차트 스킬을 찾아줘.
assertions: Preserves the explicit source order
Stops after a sufficient supported result from the earliest qualifying source
Does not reinterpret strategy as an index-versus-scan choice

cases.prompt: 이 저장소를 source로 쓰되 index:none으로 직접 스킬 패키지를 확인해서 inventory 해줘.
assertions: Does not use a source index when SourceSpec index is explicitly none
Keeps discovery within the resolved source and scope
Does not change source-combination strategy because index use was disabled

cases.prompt: target:none으로 하고 문서 작성 스킬을 찾아줘. 특정 런타임 호환성으로 후보를 거르지 마.
assertions: Does not infer or fabricate a target
Does not reject candidates solely for unrequested target compatibility
Still applies explicit capability and source constraints

cases.prompt: 내가 지정한 두 스킬 소스만 기준으로 동기화 준비 목록을 만들어줘. 다른 소스는 보지 마.
assertions: Builds a complete selection set only from the explicitly supplied sources
Does not add declared defaults or unrelated runtime catalogs
Reports unresolved identity or compatibility instead of mutating target state
